calls.statement:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 5
),
cur AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current AND category <> 'ZZ Test'),
stock AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(w.closing_units) closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week w
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = w.store_key AND s.store_id < 900
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  WHERE w.week_ending_date = (SELECT period_end_date FROM per)
  GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.quantity) units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id <> 999
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.sku = p.sku
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN (SELECT period_start_date FROM per) AND (SELECT period_end_date FROM per)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, st.category, st.closing_units,
       so.units_sold, round(so.units_sold::DOUBLE / per.weeks_in_period, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold,
       round(st.closing_units / (so.units_sold::DOUBLE / per.weeks_in_period), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM per CROSS JOIN stock st JOIN sold so USING (category)
ORDER BY st.category
